blurb:
Private rental for up to 16 guests!

We’re the only party boat charter in Nashville with Master Captains who grew up on these waters and know the area better than any tour guide. Your private rental includes coolers, ice, music, and floatables—perfect for a party atmosphere that’s still family-friendly. Bring your own beverages to enjoy while spending the day on the lake, whether you’re into water sports, anchoring at Party Cove, or relaxing in one of the quieter spots.
